source.stem:
The equation shows a chemical reaction that occurs in living organisms.
glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water Which of these characteristics of living organisms is this equation associated with?

packed_tags.topic: What is living; diversity, life cycles and plant processes

mx.teacher_note: The blue-black patches show that cellulose was produced.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The green patches of the leaf kept in the dark will turn blue-black.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: In sunlight, both the green and non-green patches will turn blue-black.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: In sunlight, starch is detected only in the originally non-green patches.

intelligence.enrichment: Starch is produced where chlorophyll-containing green leaf tissue receives sunlight; non-green patches may lack enough chlorophyll, and a leaf kept in the dark does not show starch formation. Green patch plus sunlight -> detectable starch; non-green patch or darkness -> no detectable starch in the iodine test. The learner correctly applies this rule: Starch is produced where chlorophyll-containing green leaf tissue receives sunlight; non-green patches may lack enough chlorophyll, and a leaf kept in the dark does not show starch formation. Sunlight affects the whole leaf equally, so every patch on a sunlit leaf should give the same starch result.
